facts.fact: The article states incidents are declared to the Agence nationale de la sécurité informatique (ANSI), so the national body exists and operates; as_of is the 2022 count year.
The article states incidents declared to ANSI rose by over 146% in 2022, from 63,000 in 2021 to over 155,000.

note: National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 is only stated finalised, not adopted, so no strategy fact.
